name: Wind Gate: Evacuate comes and goes as a plain temporary spell without a chat line, a button or an unlearn
contract: Wind Gate: Evacuate 504643 is a plain temporary learn, not a swap: SyncEvacuate
(AscensionStormbringerWindGate.cpp:65-76) teaches it with learnSpell(504643, true) whenever Wind Gate 504401 is
an active spell and removes it with removeSpell(504643, SPEC_MASK_ALL, true) when it is not, from
216-229). No creature or cast is needed: learning and unlearning Wind Gate drives it, like deploying and
detonating a mine drives Remote Detonation. The same silence rule applies: the learn is quiet (SpellCustomAttr
row 19810 pushed with the quiet-learn bit), the removal never reaches the client, no SMSG_SUPERCEDED_SPELL is
sent, an empty button stays empty, and a cast of 504643 while the server no longer knows it is refused by
HandleCastSpellOpcode with SPELL_FAILED_CASTER_AURASTATE (22) rather than dropped silently.
